# Rupert Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old  <sub>[v5 c31 P20](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0020)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Rupert has dark-blue, unafraid, straightforward eyes and brown hair with golden glints, inheriting these features from his deceased mother. He is a small boy whose thin feet are sometimes bare when playing outside.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Rupert is a merry, endearing, and brave boy who possesses a deep fascination with small creatures and nature. He is bold in accepting punishment and tries to avoid causing his father distress, though he can be rash and thoughtless in his antics.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c12 P28](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0028), [v5 c31 P9](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0009), [v5 c31 P10](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0010), [v5 c33 P21](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0021), [v5 c33 P27](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0027)_

## Traits

- Endearing and merry  <sub>[v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Fascinated by insects and small animals  <sub>[v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Courageous and dutiful  <sub>[v5 c31 P10](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0010), [v5 c33 P27](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0027)</sub>
- Thoughtless and rash  <sub>[v5 c12 P28](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Handling wild creatures and insects  <sub>[v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c11 P22](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To clear his honor and prove his bravery  <sub>[v5 c31 P9](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0009)</sub>

## History

Rupert lived at the Glen St. Agnes manse under the care of his father and elderly Aunt Martha. He spent much of his time exploring, playing in the graveyard with his siblings, and keeping unusual animal companions, such as snakes and insects, which led him to sleep in his old crib rather than share a bed. On one occasion, he retrieved a snake from the cellar using a forked stick. During a frightful experience in Fern Hollow, he fled from what he believed was a ghost, prompting his brother Tobias to assign him a penalty watch in the cemetery until midnight. Remaining on Hezekiah Pollock's tombstone in a cold rainstorm to fulfill his punishment, Rupert contracted severe double pneumonia and nearly died before recovering with the aid of Dr. Carrow and local care. Later, after putting a live eel in Mrs. Carr's buggy, his father prepared to whip him for the prank but proved unable to go through with the lashing upon looking into Rupert's eyes. When his father planned a four-week wedding trip, arrangements were made for Rupert to stay at Elder Clow's household.
